TS-Pico 2.3 is firmware 2.3 with ROM 2.3. **The two go together**: firmware 2.3 needs ROM 2.3, so install both. The web updater does both in one run, and on Windows the new **TS-Pico-Updater.exe** does the same.

**Coming from 1.1?** Read [What's new in the TS-Pico since 1.1](https://timex-sinclair-projects.github.io/tspico-firmware-build/updates/whats-new-since-1-1/).

## ROM 2.3

- **The TS-Pico decides what a key means.** At a "Scroll?" prompt, a menu or a yes/no question, the ROM now sends every key to the TS-Pico, `N` included, and the TS-Pico ends the exchange. You'll see one change: **ERASE with a pattern** (`ERASE "*.bak"`) takes **N** as "skip this file" and goes on to ask about the next one. It used to stop asking. Keys go as typed, so `n` and `N` both work everywhere. (#227)
- **Text from the TS-Pico can carry every colour, and the 2068's graphics.** INK 0 (black), PAPER 3 (magenta), FLASH, BRIGHT, INVERSE and OVER now get through, and so do block graphics, UDGs and keywords. Before, any of them ended the text. (#228)
- **The ROM tells the TS-Pico which ROM it is**, and `SAVE "tpi:info"` shows it on its ROM line. That line now reports what your 2068 is actually running.
- `PRINT PEEK 101` gives **35** (23h), and the start-up line reads `2026 TS-Pico ROM v2.3`.

## Also new

- **TS-Pico-Updater.exe** for Windows, where the web updater can't write the firmware. It works like the web page: choose **Latest release**, **Connect to TS-Pico**, tick the options, **Start**. (#225)
- **The user manual as PDFs**: a half-letter copy to read, and a booklet to print double-sided, fold and staple. Both are attached below. (#222)
- **[Testing TS-Pico Programs in an Emulator](https://timex-sinclair-projects.github.io/tspico-firmware-build/manual/emulators.html)**: ZEsarUX and Fuse with the real TS-Pico firmware. (#221)

## For programmers

- **Function 86h reads on after every key.** A machine-code program that prints an 86h listing must send the key and keep reading until the 03h, even after `N`: the TS-Pico echoes the key and then sends the 03h. A program that stops at its own `N` leaves those bytes behind, and the next command reads them as its status. The programmer's manual's `GET_REPLY` does it the new way, and also passes control-code values and bytes of 80h and above to `RST 10h`.
- **Byte 2 of a command pre-header is the ROM's version, 23h**, not FFh. Send the same from your own code.
- The [programmer's manual](https://timex-sinclair-projects.github.io/tspico-firmware-build/manual/programmers-manual.html) and the [programmer's reference](https://timex-sinclair-projects.github.io/tspico-firmware-build/docs/) describe 2.3.

## Testing

The new ROM code runs in the repository's Z80 interpreter against a model TS-Pico, from the committed image. The firmware's prompts have host tests for every key. On a TS-Pico with ROM 2.3, these were checked:
- `tpi:info` shows ROM 2.3.
- `y` and `n` at a Scroll? prompt, then a clean next command.
- `tpi:cd` cancelled with `n`.
- ERASE with a pattern, with `n` skipping one file.
- The CAT colours.

## Installing

1. **Switch the TS-2068 off.**
2. Open the [web updater](https://timex-sinclair-projects.github.io/tspico-firmware-build/updater/) in Chrome or Edge, connect the TS-Pico by USB, choose **Latest release**, and follow the steps. On Windows, run **TS-Pico-Updater.exe** from this release instead.
3. The updater ticks **Update the TS-2068 ROM** for every board not already on 2.3. Leave it ticked: without ROM 2.3, firmware 2.3 doesn't work properly. The ROM update erases the Pico's own files first and puts fresh ones back, so settings you changed in `config.ini` go back to their defaults. The SD card is not touched.
4. Keep the **P10 jumper** fitted.

Afterwards, `SAVE "tpi:info"` shows firmware 2.3 and ROM 2.3. `PRINT PEEK 101` gives **35** (ROM 2.3).

## Downloads

- `firmware.uf2`: the TS-Pico firmware, for dragging onto the Pico's RPI-RP2 drive by hand.
- `upgrade.uf2`: the ROM updater.
- `TS-Pico-Updater.exe`: the updater for Windows.
- `Pico-v2.3.rom`: the whole 512K flash image.
- `user-manual-half-letter.pdf`, `user-manual-saddle-stitch-letter.pdf`: the user manual.
- `pico_host-*.zip`: the TS-Pico firmware for emulators, for macOS, Linux and Windows. Use it with ROM 2.3. See the emulator guide.
- The release zip: the firmware, the Pico's files, ROM 2.3 (`src/rom/TSPICO-23.ROM`) and the SD card files.
